meta.title: Savings are recalculated after the extended end, not at the original end
gaps: The available vocabulary does not expose assertion fields for standard or custom savings, so the recalculated values and their use of the improved price are not verified.
The available vocabulary cannot verify that custom savings appear about 2 seconds and standard savings about 5 seconds after the new end.
the decisive step tests something else than the case's point: The setup does not explicitly guarantee a reference price, and the bid price is fixed at 1 because no prior bid price token is available.
it depends on a company setting this run does not change (show_custom_savings) — a failure is reported as couldn't tell, not as a bug

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event where the invited QA vendor has submitted a bid; bidding still open.
steps: The buyer moves the round's bid end time with the increase auction time moved later, with the remarks set to “QA_Platform_extend_…”.
The invited QA vendor prices the line on the bid at 1.
The invited QA vendor submits the bid.
Wait until the round's bid end time has passed.
As the buyer, read the trade best line wise savings request and check that Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked).
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked).
